description: This file defines the MockSSPILibrary class used for unit testing SSPI library calls on Windows, including methods for handling security credentials, security contexts, and expectations for security package info queries.

classes.name: MockSSPILibrary
classes.description: A mock implementation of SSPILibrary for unit testing, allowing expectations to be set for security package info queries and tracking active credentials and contexts.

methods.name: MockSSPILibrary
methods.description: Constructor for MockSSPILibrary, initializes with a package name.

methods.name: ExpectQuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets an expectation for a QuerySecurityPackageInfo call with specified response code and package info.
